name: What makes a good AEO partner for a CPA firm?

mainEntity.name: What makes a good AEO partner for a CPA firm?

acceptedAnswer.text: A good AEO partner for a CPA firm possesses a deep understanding of both AI-driven search technologies and the specific nuances of the accounting and financial services industry. They should demonstrate expertise in content strategy, structured data implementation, semantic SEO, and natural language processing. Furthermore, a strong partner will have a proven track record of helping professional service firms achieve greater online visibility, transparent reporting on AEO metrics, and a proactive approach to adapting strategies as AI models evolve. Their focus should be on establishing your firm as a primary knowledge source for AI.
acceptedAnswer.description: A good AEO partner for a CPA firm combines expertise in AI search technologies, accounting industry nuances, content strategy, and a track record of enhancing online visibility for professional services.
